title: Lightning account handoff prep — Juno
body:
Meeting: 15-min lightning handoff with AE (Samir Kapoor) — goal: align on next 30d plays and immediate risks

Quick context (one-liner): BrightWave (mid-market retail) upsell to Dedicated tracking; current ARR $180k, usage spike last 6 weeks, some latency complaints on multi-region tests. Renewal in 160 days.

Top signals to call out:
- Support tickets: 3 P2s last 30d (LAT-211, LAT-223, CONF-19) — root cause appears to be tokenization/regression in 2.3 runtime path
- Usage: avg tokens/day 2.1M -> 3.6M over last 2 weeks (burst pattern, evening spikes PST)
- Cost sensitivity: customer requested cost forecast for Dedicated vs Hosted by EOW
- Health: NPS touch shows promoter -> neutral shift after demo latency incident

Meeting agenda (quick bullets):
1) 60s recap of where we are (contract basics, ARR, renewal window)
2) Current ops issues — who owns follow-ups (Support/SRE/AE)
3) Immediate asks for next 30d (pilot sizing, PO approvals, escalation paths)
4) Actions and owners (commit to dates)

Notes / talking points to use:
- "Baseline: renewal in ~5 months; main blocker is perceived reliability under peak traffic."
- "We can offer a short Dedicated pilot (4 weeks) with cost caps — need product + infra signoff."
- "Ask: do they want traffic shaping or regional pinning first? Preference impacts infra lead time."

Open questions to surface to AE in 1:1:
- Which internal exec is driving the renewal? (Sales reports VP of Ops is tangentially involved)
- Any legal procurement constraints on new PO timing?
- Do they have an upcoming traffic forecast or marketing event that spikes tokens in April?

Quick risk matrix (verbal):
- High: sustained latency under evening spikes -> churn risk if not addressed before renewal
- Medium: budget pushback on Dedicated until pilot proves <20% cost delta
- Low: feature gap in structured outputs (not blocker for Dedicated but noted)

Proposed immediate actions (owner / by when):
- CS: draft pilot success criteria & monitoring dashboard (me) — due 2026-03-19
- AE: obtain LOE estimate from infra for 4-week Dedicated pilot (Samir) — due 2026-03-16
- SRE/Infra: re-run perf tests with evening load profile and share results (Aisha) — due 2026-03-18
- Support: consolidate P2 RCA summaries and update ticket with remediation ETA (Support team) — due 2026-03-15

Pre-send to AE before sync (attachments I will add):
- Short 1-pager: pilot plan + acceptance criteria
- Recent token usage CSV (last 90 days)
- Links to the three P2 RCAs and the demo recording from 2026-02-28

If AE asks for pricing cadence:
- We can propose a capped pilot credit + conversion discount if they sign Dedicated within 30d of pilot close. I will draft proposed numbers after infra LOE is in.

Follow-up cadence if pilot agreed: weekly 30m sync (CS + AE + Infra) + daily async updates in account channel.

Parking lot (not for this 15-min):
- Discuss packaging for multi-region fallbacks and fallthrough model variants
- Prepare a short exec deck (1 slide) comparing Hosted vs Dedicated economics for their 6-12 month forecast

My immediate checklist post-1:1 (me):
- [ ] Send pilot 1-pager to Samir + cc infra/support (today)
- [ ] Create account channel in Slack + invite AE, infra lead, support lead (today)
- [ ] Kickoff JIRA board for pilot tasks + template ticket for RCAs (today)
- [ ] Draft proposed conversion discount scenarios (by 2026-03-17)

Short coping language for the call if they escalate: \"We hear the latency concerns, we have a few fast levers (regional pinning + dedicated pilot) and a clear timeline — we'll publicize the test plan within 48 hours and share interim metrics during the pilot.\"

Notes to self: stay concise, prioritize dates and owners, avoid deep technical debates in this 15-min — surface and schedule follow-ups.

—— end scratchpad —
